t: The Next Great Web Cleanup: Designing for AI Readability
s: The article argues for a future-proof web development approach prioritizing AI readability, moving away from complex JS frameworks towards durable technologies like Python and HTMX. This shift mirrors the mobile-first revolution, emphasizing semantic HTML and accessibility features as crucial for AI parsing.
